scope: Proposition 8.3 (Two saturated witnesses) of the manuscript “The Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis: A Zero-Free Half-Plane $`\Re s\gt 7/8`$” (preprints/The-Quasi-Riemann-Hypothesis-September-30-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 003 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8fe93046f8cf5ef1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 59. statement: Let u have a bin (i, a) with a > 51/100, and assume the loss and height hypotheses of Lemma 8.2. For every t ∈ [1, 3/2], and every prescribed ϵ > 0, after reducing its preliminary losses, there are ψ ∈ Xu, a zero ρ = σ+iγ as in Lemma 8.1, dyadic lengths D = Ur, N = Um, and two polynomials Mr, Sm for the common row character ψ such that r ≤ t + O(1/ log U), r + m ≥ t − O(1/ log U), |MrSm|2 ≫A,ϵ Uδ(r+m)−ϵ . (8.3) Their lengths and individual values also satisfy t − 1 2 − O(ϵ) ≤ r ≤ t + O(1/ log U), 0 ≤ m ≤ 1 2 + O(ϵ), |Mr|2 ≫A,ϵ Uδr−ϵ , |Sm|2 ≫A,ϵ Uδm−ϵ . (8.4) The constants in the O(ϵ) terms are absolute on the stated parameter ranges. Both polynomials have the same twist height γ − ν, where |ν| ≤ cT1 for a fixed c > 0 chosen within the cumulative frequency allowance. Their untwisted profiles form a uniformly smooth annular family. For each row, both witnesses use one presentation ψu,ϑ,ς, selected by a label (ϑ, ς) in the fixed finite set Θ × {−1, 1}. The presentation itself varies with u. The dyadic pair can likewise be selected separately for each row from O((log U)2) possibilities.
